title: Linguistic effects beyond natural-movie covariates
disposition_reason: The paired held-out neural-response evaluator is delivered and distinguishes EV from R². It verifies declared prediction/fit IDs, not actual fitting or clinical electrode correspondence; native preparation and a competent fixed nuisance/full reference remain missing.

scientific_target.question: Do prespecified linguistic features improve held-out neural-response prediction beyond speaker, acoustics, visual motion and word timing under person/movie and temporal separation?
scientific_target.known_answer: The full-minus-nuisance held-out neural prediction contrast on identical scalar response rows; negative, zero or inconclusive increments are valid empirical outcomes.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Operator-private scalar responses derived from actual Brain Treebank intracranial signals under a frozen response definition/window. Published biological narrative is not the answer key.
scientific_target.case_unit: An electrode response row within one continuous recording block; scoring is nested by block, electrode and person.
scientific_target.independent_unit: 10 clinical participants, with26 recording presentations and21 movies; electrode/word count does not increase biological n.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Predictive contribution conditional on measured nuisance features and a verified fit protocol; no causal effect of language or clinical population guarantee.
exclusions: Causal linguistic mechanism from incremental prediction alone
Cross-person prediction without independently resolved electrode/output mapping
Source paper GLM reproduction inferred from prospective held-out contrasts

inputs: Permitted continuous acoustic/visual/speaker/word-timing features and declared linguistic regressors for encoding; training neural responses only.
Query linguistic/nuisance observations with nonpositive feature lags and fixed response-window guard; query neural responses remain private.
forbidden_inputs: Held-out neural responses during feature/electrode selection, normalization, tuning or model fit
Cross-fold person/movie overlap or response-window leakage
Using row-index rolling as an autocorrelation control for irregular word times
observation_contract.case_identity: Exact row IDs bind participant/movie/recording/electrode/block/time; all26 canonical recordings are accounted for as included or explicitly excluded. Source electrode and word completeness is not discovered by the evaluator.
observation_contract.split: Each fold forbids training/test participant, movie, recording and block overlap; complete blocks must be scored together. Native cross-person electrode representation and source inclusion require separate review.
observation_contract.coverage: Every declared row and included recording is scored, with all26 source recordings visible. Frozen exclusions are permitted but cannot be interpreted as validated full-population/electrode coverage.

primary.name: delta_r2
primary.aggregation: Compute held-block R² full-minus-nuisance; equal-average blocks within electrode, electrodes within person, then people.
primary.rationale: This revision prospectively selects the SSE-based signed delta R² estimand because it penalizes constant bias; either sign is scientifically valid. A larger incremental effect alone is not more accurate understanding and can result from weakening nuisance prediction. Any programme ranking uses absolute full-model held-target R² against an independently fixed competent nuisance/reference procedure. Submitted claim correctness is error against the independently computed contrast. Historical delta-EV remains distinct.

secondary: delta_explained_variance computed separately because residual variance ignores constant bias
Absolute nuisance/full R² and EV, per-person/electrode/block contrasts and exclusion accounting
Refitted joint linguistic temporal-shift contrasts and descriptive add-one rank where assumptions hold

comparators.name: Fixed nuisance-only encoding model
comparators.inputs: Speaker, acoustics, visual motion and word timing, no linguistic features
comparators.procedure: Proposed training-only ridge/GLM reference using identical response/folds and frozen hyperparameter selection; actual competent fit is not delivered.

comparators.name: Same model plus linguistic features
comparators.inputs: Same nuisance features plus prespecified lexical/syntax regressors
comparators.procedure: Matched capacity/selection policy needed so feature contribution is not a search-budget difference.

comparators.name: Refitted linguistic temporal-shift control
comparators.inputs: All linguistic columns jointly shifted within uniform-time blocks; nuisance unchanged
comparators.procedure: Source utility exists for uniform grids only; native irregular word-time conditional null needs a separately justified construction.

nuisance_controls: Select anatomy/electrodes, preprocessing and hyperparameters using training only.
Preserve common movie identities across participants in fold grouping.
Freeze response statistic/window and full lag support; guards cover response and feature extents.
Verify actual fit artifacts and signal provenance; hashes alone do not prove target isolation.

Do not optimize a submitted explanation toward a positive language increment or weaken the nuisance arm. Freeze the independent nuisance procedure and retain absolute full/nuisance quality; score submitted contrast claims by agreement regardless of sign.
evaluation.uncertainty: Source paired participant bootstrap describes selected-cohort contrasts and omits intervals for one person. Repeated stimuli, common model training and clinical electrode selection require additional treatment before population inference; null rank is descriptive, not a calibrated p-value.
evaluation.failure_policy: Reject constant target blocks, nonfinite values, duplicate/missing/extra rows or split-block outputs. Negative increments remain valid; do not select favorable electrodes after testing. Full constant predictions follow the predeclared report/reject policy.

implementation.scorer_target: Computes genuine held-response EV/R² contrasts from private targets and supplied nuisance/full predictions, with declared split/fit checks and hierarchical aggregation. It does not train or verify the submitted models or recover native responses.
implementation.delivered_scope: Prospective numerical evaluator, source roster checks, paired summaries and uniform-time shift utility with generated controls; no authentic neural pipeline or executed reference.
missing: Resolve native response extraction, complete electrode/word inventory and cross-person output mapping.
Execute fixed matched nuisance/full reference under verified train-only fitting.
Bind genuine signal/feature/fit lineage and protect query targets.
Justify conditional temporal null for irregular native word times.
implementation.execution_evidence: Documentation records generated EV/R², bias, temporal-leakage and CLI checks; no authentic model/recording execution.

direct_observation.representation: A no-tools analyst could interpret a frozen quantitative contrast display, but the displayed answer cannot itself be used as a prediction target. No withheld-answer direct condition is delivered.
direct_observation.boundary: Only the declared observation/demonstration context, no external tools or evaluator feedback; a new direct condition needs an independently frozen view and complete output identity.
missing: No delivered participant condition establishes this mode for the same scientific target.

typed_viewer.representation: Signal visualization can support diagnosis of extraction/alignment; no typed viewer is supplied and it would not by itself estimate a whole-cohort linguistic increment.
typed_viewer.boundary: Only typed render/navigation actions with audited limits; no raw arrays, labels, filenames or external source retrieval returned to the participant.
missing: No delivered participant condition establishes this mode for the same scientific target.

tool_assisted.representation: Source evaluator and control utility support operator numerical analysis; a target-isolated adaptive participant investigation loop remains absent.
tool_assisted.boundary: Same permitted observations, frozen checkpoint tools and accounted compute as the compared arm; case state and feedback policy must be fixed before query.
missing: No delivered participant condition establishes this mode for the same scientific target.

frozen_program.representation: A frozen nuisance/full predictor pair can emit the implemented schema, but no protected model fit/predict runner or qualified reference is supplied.
frozen_program.boundary: Freeze code and fitting/adaptation recipe before queries; admit only explicitly allowed labels/calibration, retain all failed/incomplete cases.
missing: No delivered participant condition establishes this mode for the same scientific target.
